title: Final Momentum Amplitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and express the probability amplitude in momentum space, psi(p, 0).

title: Final Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the time-dependent wave function, psi(x, t).

title: Integral Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the integral for transforming psi(x, 0) to momentum space.

title: Exponential Terms
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly handle the exponential terms in the integral during the transformation process.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the exponential terms.
